verdict.rationale: Make is an automation platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities: an AI Agents app and API for agentic automation, an MCP server that lets external AI clients run and manage scenarios, and a non-AI analytics endpoint. None documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data inside the product, so these earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
